name: longbowman
description: a Longbowman (Fall from Heaven), a human soldier: a round steel kettle helmet over a grey mail coif, a green tunic with cream trim, a brown leather belt and baldric, tan trousers and brown leather boots, a quiver of white-fletched arrows on his back at the screen-left, and a tall wooden longbow held out in his LEFT hand (screen-right) with an arrow nocked and drawn to his cheek by his RIGHT hand (screen-left)
hands: the longbow stays in his left hand on the screen-right side, held out at arm's length; his right hand on the screen-left side draws the string and arrow back to his cheek

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk (the right hand jolted off the string to the chest, its elbow out to the left, still clutching the arrow; the bow arm jerked out to the right with the longbow upright and raised)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the longbow tipping forward with its top leaning out to the right, the right hand still at the chest with the arrow

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, bow arm flung up with the longbow upright, the arrow falling from the right hand
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the longbow lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, one end of the longbow resting on the ground at the lower-right, the right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the longbow slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the kettle helmet tipping
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the kettle helmet still on; the longbow lies on the ground at the lower-right; the quiver under his shoulders, a few arrows spilled
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the kettle helmet stays on
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the longbow on the ground beside him
